input.objective: Identify the exact San Francisco city agency responsible for this issue and the official reporting channel with its URL. Issue category: water_sewer. Prefer official city government pages such as sf.gov and 311.
queries: San Francisco report water leak sewer SFPUC

value.title: Report flooding, water leaks, sewer backup, or odor issues | SF.gov
value.excerpt: The San Francisco Public Utilities Commission handles water main breaks, sewer backups, clogged catch basins and street flooding.

value.title: 311 Customer Service Center | SF.gov
value.excerpt: SF 311 is the city's single point of contact for non emergency service requests. Call 311, use the web forms, or use the SF311 mobile app.
